ARC1820I.description: QUERY COPYPOOL: aktywna background copy FlashCopy (tabela w liniach CONT.)
ARC1820I.pattern: ^THE FOLLOWING VOLUMES IN COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>[^,\s]+),\s*VERSION (?<version>\d+),\s*HAVE AN ACTIVE FLASHCOPY BACKGROUND COPY(?:\s+(?<volumes>.*))?

ARC1821I.description: QUERY COPYPOOL: brak aktywnej background copy
ARC1821I.pattern: ^NONE OF THE VOLUMES IN COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>[^,\s]+),\s*VERSION (?<version>\d+),\s*HAVE AN ACTIVE FLASHCOPY BACKGROUND COPY

ARC1853I.description: QUERY COPYPOOL nieudane - copy pool zajety
ARC1853I.pattern: ^FAST REPLICATION QUERY HAS FAILED FOR COPY POOL (?<copy_pool>[^,\s]+),\s*COPY POOL COULD NOT BE SERIALIZED,\s*RC=\s*(?<rc>\d+)
